note: Track sight-singing (voice-melodies), step 1: three tunes that move by step, each read and sung from the staff before the app plays it. missing: a melody-singer prop that starts the mic without playing the tune, so the first reading is drawn and checked too.

exercise.title: Read a tune that moves by step
exercise.why: On the staff a step is the move from a line to the space next to it, so a tune that moves only by step can be read one small move at a time from its first note.

cells.text:
Tap the first note of the tune below to hear it, before you press Play. Each note after it sits one step higher or lower on the staff. Sing the tune from the staff on the note names, at your own pace.
Then press Play below to hear the tune, and check what you sang against it.
Once your reading matches the tune, read it in another key. Use the Key selector below to change the key, then tap the first note again.
When you change the key, the notes sit in new places on the staff but each one is still a step from the last.

This tune starts on Sol and only steps down. Tap its first note below to hear it. Sing the tune from the staff on the note names, then press Play below to hear it.
If you lose your place, tap the note you stopped on and go on from there.

This tune is four bars long, and each bar ends on a long note. Tap its first note below to hear it. Sing the tune from the staff on the note names, one bar at a time.
Then press Play below to hear the tune, and sing along to check each bar.
Once you can read it through without stopping, sing it again on "la".
